svg.text: C4 Component Diagram — Decision & Policy Service
Scope: one C4 container · proposed design · supporting systems are outside the container boundary.

text.tspan: Decision & Policy Service — C4 container boundary
Builds LEAVE, recommendation, or bounded proposal from fresh context.
Reads current resource state and validated observation history.
Requests generic prediction output through the inference contract.
Applies OBSERVE_ONLY defaults and independent CPU, RAM, and I/O gates.
Sends only admitted, bounded actions; receives verified outcome.
Persists status/recommendation projections and decision evidence.

Key: blue rectangles are components; teal cylinders are the separate SQLite databases; grey boxes are external systems/interfaces. UML port squares, required sockets, and provided lollipops show named interfaces. Dashed arrows show consumer → provider dependency by project convention.
